what_this_is: A read of Atlas Assets (tblFMzOKcNQTjXVYS) for organisations whose imagery is published, in the Atlas REST shape. An entry here is NOT permission: apply_authorised_imagery.py publishes an asset only if Rights Status is 'Supplier Provided', Publication Status is 'Approved', the Notes record whether it is a photograph or a visualisation, the organisation holds a LIVE grant in image-rights-manifest.json, the URL sits inside that grant's scoped prefix and the asset is linked to the product. publish-targeted-update.py replaces one organisation's rows from a fresh Atlas read; it never adds rows for anyone else.
